# Provenance + integrity record for the vendored report assets (#332/#540 —
# the report scripts AND the build-time report.css).
# The sha256s below are ENFORCED by report_vendor_test.go
# (TestVendoredReportScriptHashes). An upgrade is the full recipe: the
# vendored blob + the sha256 here + the go:embed list and vendorScripts names
# in report.go + the template literals + the version banner marker in
# report_issue332_test.go (a regen changes the banner) + the version-pin
# freshness binding in test_class_coverage_test.go — all in one commit.
# Tampering in git is detectable. Renovate never touches this file:
# config:recommended's :ignoreModulesAndTests preset adds **/vendor/** to
# ignorePaths (verified: a no-extends config extracts it, the preset one
# does not) and the standard ignores are deliberately not overridden —
# provenance here is hand-maintained.
#
# report.css
#   source: BUILT — tailwind/ (the #540 prebuilt-CSS migration; the
#         runtime compiler was retired). Regen recipe (documented in
#         tailwind/package.json): cd tailwind && npm ci --ignore-scripts
#         && ./node_modules/.bin/tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js
#         -i input.css -o ../vendor/report.css --minify
#         Then update the sha256 below AND in report_vendor_test.go.
#         (ALWAYS ./node_modules/.bin/tailwindcss — NEVER npx, which can
#         fetch a different version on resolution failure.) The clean-
#         runner reproducibility of this recipe is enforced in CI (the
#         Report CSS reproducibility job: regen + cmp vs the committed
#         bytes). The palette lives in tailwind/palette.json (the single
#         source of truth, read by the Go coverage test); the version pin
#         in tailwind/package.json (the npm channel is LIVE for the CLI —
#         a v3 security bump is a valid regen; v4 is a config-format
#         migration, capped <4 in renovate.json).
#         The OLD blob (tailwindcss-3.4.17.js, the Play-CDN runtime
#         compiler) was deleted by this migration — its 26 lines of
#         channel history are in git.
#   sha256: 9c146ec362d03090688714f48f0241b4262ea6b19c819bbe020c75a6526d477e
#
# chart-4.5.1.umd.min.js
#   source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.5.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js
#   npm anchor: registry.npmjs.org/chart.js/-/chart.js-4.5.1.tgz
#     dist.integrity: sha512-GIjfiT9dbmHRiYi6Nl2yFCq7kkwdkp1W/lp2J99rX0yo9tgJGn3lKQATztIjb5tVtevcBtIdICNWqlq5+E8/Pw==
#     (the fetched tarball hashes to it; its inner dist/chart.umd.min.js is the
#      bytes below — jsdelivr serves the same file, both verified 2026-09-05)
